result.title: MeshQuery: Agentic Seam Planning for UV Parametrization
result.summary: We present MeshQuery, a training-free agentic approach to automatic UV unwrapping of production-grade quad meshes. A Vision-Language Model (VLM) plans artist-aligned seams using a set of edge-selection tools, conditioned on domain-specific UV-unwrapping knowledge expressed in natural language and refined with a feedback loop. We design a queryable mesh representation together with a domain-specific language (DSL) that enables the agent to retrieve mesh information on demand, express a seam plan as a compact program of edge-selection operators over topological, geometric, and semantic mesh attributes, and iteratively refine it from UV quality feedback. On Adobe Substance 3D and Toys4K meshes, MeshQuery produces 2.9x/4.29x fewer charts and 1.63x/1.7x shorter seams than the strongest baseline, and professional artists prefer its results in 80.9% of comparisons. Ultimately, decoupling high-level intent planning from low-level edge selection and compact mesh representation lets MeshQuery run on different backend VLMs and scale to meshes an order of magnitude larger than autoregressive seam prediction

AI.brief_summary: MeshQuery 提出一种免训练的 VLM 智能体方法做四边形网格的 UV 展开接缝规划：用可查询网格表示与 DSL 让智能体按需取网格信息、把接缝计划写成边选择算子程序，并借助 UV 质量反馈迭代改进。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按需查询几何/拓扑/语义属性 + 以 DSL 程序表达计划 + 质量反馈迭代」可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、latent 计划表示与停止/修正决策提供可核查的组织形式，但面向的是 3D 网格 UV 任务，与 VLM 内部推理状态的关联尚待核查。
